name: io.github.salitaba/maven-decoder-mcp
title: Maven Decoder
description: Lets AI agents read the real source of any Maven dependency, decompiled from ~/.m2 or Central.

environmentVariables.name: MAVEN_REPOSITORY
environmentVariables.description: Path to the local Maven repository. Defaults to ~/.m2/repository.

environmentVariables.name: MAVEN_REMOTE_REPOS
environmentVariables.description: Comma or whitespace separated list of remote Maven repository base URLs.

environmentVariables.name: MAVEN_REMOTE_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Username for authenticating against private remote Maven repositories.

environmentVariables.name: MAVEN_REMOTE_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Password or token for authenticating against private remote Maven repositories.

environmentVariables.name: MAVEN_OFFLINE
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to disable all network access and use only the local repository.

environmentVariables.name: MAVEN_AUTO_DOWNLOAD
environmentVariables.description: Whether to automatically download missing artifacts from remote repositories. Defaults to true.

environmentVariables.name: MAVEN_DECODER_CACHE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Override directory used for decompilation and metadata caches.
